entries.text: API keys: service, personal and platform tokens with scopes and live or test mode, sent as a bearer token.

Pass create with a key: templateVersion, releaseId and releaseGeneration are optional together. Send none and the server uses the approved release; with none it answers TEMPLATE_RELEASE_REQUIRED (409). Some but not all is 422.
mode on pass create defaults to the key's mode; a mismatch is MODE_MISMATCH (409).
Lists: a global key or a session without orgId gets ORG_REQUIRED (422). A session listing a forbidden org's passes gets 403, not an empty 200.
Uploaded templates start with a legacy release at their active version, so existing integrations keep creating passes. New versions need a candidate, a second reviewer and a release.
